photos.c:
This picture was taken during the 1931 - 34 period and shows some famous Belgravians of that time. We have no record of the race concerned except to know that J.E.FLOWER (right) was the winner.

W.L.(Wally) BAYLISS, our then General Honorary Secretary, is the timekeeper, while W.H.(Harry) HARE, Past President and Honorary Treasurer, acts as recorder. The man gaining a sneak preview of the result is the ubiquitous TOM CARTER, and the man with the eyeful, A. (Micky) WALKER.
Names to fit the faces left to right are: -. Mitchell, H.W.Shields (Mx), J.E.Flower (Mx), A.Allum (Mx), W.Bayliss, A.W.Penny (Sy), A.E.Taylor (Sy), H.E.Footer (Sy), C.T.Carter (Sy).
L to R   A.Allum, H.E.Footer, A.E.Taylor, A.R.Shaw, S.Warboys Arthur Penny, J.E.Flower, H.W.Shields, Tom Carter and W.A.Rice
